ai_summary: The funding supports the establishment of a Clinical and Data Coordinating Center to enhance diagnosis for undiagnosed diseases. Eligible applicants include various organizations such as tribal governments, federal agencies, and community-based organizations, with a focus on demonstrating operational readiness and stakeholder partnerships.
ai_quote: support a new phase of the Undiagnosed Diseases Network (UDN) to advance diagnosis for individuals with previously undiagnosed diseases
